name: NextBoat Inc.
summary: Off The Hook YS, Inc. specializes in the acquisition, resale, and wholesale distribution of yachts and boats. Its operations are divided into two primary divisions: Dealerships and Financing Services. The Dealership segment primarily handles the retail of both new and previously owned watercraft. Conversely, the Financing Services arm offers credit solutions to private clients seeking to acquire marine vessels, aircraft, or recreational vehicles. Founded in 2012 by Jason Ruegg, the firm's main office is located in Wilmington, North Carolina.
